node_policy: Every listed repository is a bidirectional logical federation node.
routing: repository -> repository -> capability -> action -> evidence -> verification -> provenance -> evolution
non_fabrication: Logical cross-links do not imply live runtime connectivity, credentials, or external endpoint availability.
edge_rule: For every ordered pair (A,B), the federation records a logical route A -> B; self-routes are represented only as local maintenance actions, not peer edges.
evolution_rule: New links and capabilities are additive and require evidence before promotion.
security_rule: Do not propagate secrets, credentials, financial data, or private material through federation manifests.
